rng_stream_convention: SeedSequence([seed,i]).spawn(2) -> (rng_pileup, rng_suppression) independent streams per event

pool_generation_settings.note: 125,000-event pool per the paper's own Sec III D; this project uses 20,000 events by explicit user decision, not a paper requirement or a feasibility finding -- see RUN_LOG.md 2026-09-16 ~14:40. Sampling from this pool is WITH REPLACEMENT (documented assumption, not specified by the paper or ref[34]), so results have REDUCED STATISTICAL INDEPENDENCE relative to the paper's own 125,000-event pool and must never be described as an exact paper-sized reproduction.

suppression_mechanism: track-level Bernoulli removal, Phase 4 (track_suppression.py) -- modelling assumption, not a uniquely specified paper prescription
